findings.title: Pagination behavior was changed
findings.detail: The frozen implementation replaces the prior single list request with an automatic loop of up to 100 requests and returns nextCursor: null. This consumes all pages and removes the cursor needed for pagination, violating the task requirement to preserve pagination behavior.
